mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fault_repairs (uid, name, phone, fault_type, fault_desc, state, time, files) VALUES (#{uid}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{faultType}, #{faultDesc}, #{state}, #{time}, #{files})
mapper.update: UPDATE fault_repairs SET name = #{name}, phone = #{phone}, fault_type = #{faultType}, files = #{files}, fault_desc = #{faultDesc} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fault_repairs ORDER BY state
SELECT * FROM fault_repairs WHERE uid = #{uid} ORDER BY state
